result.description:
Job Title: Dog Handler / Trainer
Location: 680 New South Head Road, Rose Bay
Employment Type: Full-Time (38 hours/week)
Salary: $80000 per annum + Superannuation
Benefits: 4 weeks annual leave, supportive team environment, opportunities for professional growth
About Us
At Paw Stars, we provide exceptional outdoor daycare, grooming, and animal training services for beloved family dogs. Located in Rose Bay, our passionate team is our greatest strength—each staff member is chosen for their experience, professionalism, and genuine love for animals.
We’re committed to giving dogs enriching social experiences and personalised training support that fosters their wellbeing and behavioural development.
The Role
We are seeking an experienced Dog Handler/Trainer to join our team in a dynamic, outdoor, and animal-loving environment. This role involves dog training, handling, grooming assistance, and occasional transport duties.
Key Responsibilities
1. Dog Training & Behavioural Management
Train dogs in foundational commands (e.g. sit, stay, recall) and more advanced skills as needed
Address behavioural concerns (e.g leash reactivity, anxiety, aggression) using positive reinforcement techniques
Develop and implement customised training plans for individual dogs
Monitor and report on each dog’s progress, adapting training strategies as required
2. Dog Handling & Care
Supervise and handle dogs of all breeds, sizes, and temperaments safely and confidently
Support the physical and emotional wellbeing of all dogs under your care
Provide mentally stimulating and physically enriching activities during sessions
3. Client Communication & Education
Liaise with dog owners to understand their goals and concerns
Provide guidance on continuing training techniques at home
Deliver professional feedback and written progress updates
4. Operational & Team Support
Maintain a clean, safe, and organised training environment
Comply with animal welfare regulations and company safety procedures
Collaborate with groomers, receptionists, and other team members to ensure seamless service
About You
Required Experience & Knowledge
Minimum 1 year of professional experience handling and training dogs
Strong understanding of dog behaviour, training principles, and canine health
Essential Skills
Expertise in positive reinforcement and other humane training methods
Clear, confident communication with both clients and colleagues
Patience, empathy, and adaptability
Sound judgement and problem-solving abilities when addressing behavioural challenges
Physical fitness and confidence in managing strong or high-energy dogs
Preferred Qualities
A true passion for animal welfare
Professional, reliable, and team-oriented
Calm under pressure and quick to respond to unexpected situations
Ready to Join the Pack?
If you're an enthusiastic animal care professional who thrives in an active, purpose-driven role—we’d love to hear from you!
result.title: Dog Handler/Trainer

result.description:
Construction Project Manager – Sydney CBD 

Kogan People Solutions is working with a leading provider of advisory, project and asset management services across the entire infrastructure spectrum. This respected entity offers integrated solutions across social, commercial, transport, utilities and defence infrastructure. Their teams have worked with many of Australia’s most influential brands and institutions from the government/ private and not-for-profit sectors, delivering city shaping and nation-building infrastructure. 

They now seek a Construction Project Manager to manage a multitude of projects and will enjoy a reporting line to members of the senior project team. The role is full time, and ongoing.

Our valued client Industrial Metal Services located in Queensland is a leading scrap metal merchants that specialises in buying and selling all kinds of metals.

They are seeking highly skilled and trade qualified Mechanical Technician with experience in computerised controlled machines to join their team of professionals in their Queensland Workshop.

The role includes but is not limited to:
Preparing drawings, plans and designs for mechanical engineering work under the direction of Mechanical Engineers
Conduct root cause analysis, fault-finding and diagnosing efficient solutions to machine breakdowns
Installs, removes, inspects and repairs mechanical spare parts like bearings, seals on typical mechanical equipment.
Performs major overhaul of equipment with or without external contractors and vendors.
Disassembles, assembles, observes, repairs, tests, collects data and prepares reports on equipment, as tasks related to maintenance.
Maintaining non-electrical safety, process and utility equipment.
Perform power plant rigging, and lifting equipment necessary for safely handling heavy machinery and materials.
Advise and assist engineering and scientific professional staff in the design of advanced and complex mechanical equipment or system.
Troubleshoot process equipment, automation issues that may arise at the manufacturing line.
Ensuring that products meet compliance regulations.
Troubleshooting mechanical issues.
Carry out work instructions as given by Supervisor, work specifications, equipment operation.
Supports improvement projects.
Fabricates and repair parts by using machine shop tools and equipment.
Controls downtime by performing routine preventative maintenance requirements, daily equipment inspections, and monitoring machine operational performance.
Perform duties consistent with established safety rules and procedures.
Installing and commissioning new equipment as directed.
Understand customer change request and provide schedule

To be considered for this role, you must have:
Strong mechanical aptitude and problem-solving skills.
Proven experience as a Mechanical Technician or similar role.
Knowledge of mechanical systems, tools, and equipment.
Ability to read and interpret technical manuals and blueprints.
Knowledge in wide variety of machine diagnostics software highly regarded
Documentation skills, must be able to maintain accurate records of maintenance service history
Strong attention to detail and a commitment to quality work.
Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
Safety-conscious mindset.
Self-motivated, organised, punctual and reliable
Must have great work ethics

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!
Salary: Between $79,499 and $82,000 per annum + Super
